Decent games if you're into large-scale 4X strategy and space combat, but they do get extremely grindy after a while and the entire series has its own quirky charm that some people get and find amusing and others just get cranky. Egosoft released an expansion for X3: Albion Prelude called Shady Business which was largely a community collaboration, and it was bloody awful even by X plot standards.

The games aren't expensive and the core gameplay will keep you entertained long after you got your money's worth. The end game changes and some people might not like that but you'll still have gotten dozens of hours out of the game by then.
